part.text:
Fixed in `caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go`. The lexer treated any `<<` as a heredoc opening even when followed by a space (e.g. `between <<  >>`), swallowing the space into the token and then failing marker validation on the newline.

Changes:
- A space right after `<<` now ends the token (`<<` / `>>` are just regular tokens, so `templates { between <<  >> }` adapts fine).
- The "too many `<`" check moved to the newline branch, so `<<<EOF content` on one line is a plain token while `<<<EOF\n...` still errors.
- Heredoc detection is skipped inside quoted/backtick strings, so `"<<"` lexes correctly.

All tests in `caddyconfig/caddyfile` pass (previously `TestLexer` failed on 4 cases), and real heredocs (`<<EOF\n...\nEOF`) still tokenize as before.
